units.source_text: 而他的失踪，在找不到线索这一点上，也不例外。

en.t: And his disappearance was no exception in that no clues could be found.

units.source_text: 警方推测出他大概会去的地方，可那边没有任何报告说发现了可疑的尸体；

en.t: The police worked out the places he was likely to have gone, but there were no reports from those areas of any suspicious body being found;

units.source_text: 从他的工作性质上来看，分析不出丁点儿会被人绑架的蛛丝马迹。

en.t: Judging from the nature of his work, they could not detect the slightest sign that he might have been kidnapped.

units.source_text: 平时，他也丝毫没有流露过计划逃跑的口风。

en.t: Nor had he ever, in ordinary times, given the least hint that he was planning to run away.
